title: repro status finds an instance's commit on the real main by patch-id, not only by sha
goal: repro status reports an instance commit whose change is on the real origin's main under another sha (a cherry-pick or rebase, as repro replay makes), by patch-id, so the archived instances' 'none on the real origin' is proven after a replay
